url.title: Image URL
url.description: The URL of the first generated image (when the model returns URLs). Map this directly downstream.

b64_json.title: Image Base64
b64_json.description: The base64-encoded data of the first generated image (when Response Format is b64_json).

revised_prompt.title: Revised Prompt
revised_prompt.description: The prompt the model actually used after its own rewriting, if provided.

images.title: Images
images.description: The full list of generated images — each has url and/or b64_json.

created.title: Created
created.description: Unix timestamp of when the images were generated.
